formula: (1/7) * sum of seven binary annual-accounting improvement signals
warmup_reason: Two consecutive annual reports are required for year-over-year components; the first valid score is therefore 2023-05-04.
components: total_liabilities_t / total_assets_t < the same ratio at t-1

independence.method: mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation within historical non-financial HS300 members

universe_rule: historical HS300 membership excluding banks and non-bank financials using the current industry snapshot
caveats: Only seven of the traditional Piotroski signals are available; current-ratio and share-issuance components are not present in the local contract.
The score updates annually and can be stale within a fiscal year.
Financial values are current snapshots and may contain restatements.
The industry snapshot used to exclude financials is current rather than historical PIT.
